# BestPackFactory — B2B Custom Packaging Engineering Excellence

BestPackFactory is a premier B2B custom packaging manufacturer specialized in precision engineering and high-performance materials.

## Technical Specifications & Manufacturing Scope
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: 500 PCS for custom projects.
- **Custom Packaging Types**:
  - Flexible Packaging (Stand-up pouches, flat-bottom bags, side-gusset bags).
  - Luxury Rigid Boxes (Magnetic closure, folding gift boxes, premium set-up boxes).
  - Food & Beverage Packaging (Pizza boxes, burger boxes, liquid spout pouches).
  - Medical & Pharmaceutical Packaging (Folding cartons, medical labels, blister cards).
  - Stationery Packaging (Custom PP ring binder folders, 2/3/4-ring options).
- **Advanced Capabilities**:
  - High-barrier foil laminations for long shelf life.
  - One-way degassing valves for specialty coffee.
  - Child-resistant (CR) closure systems (ASTM D3475 compliant).
  - 360-degree vibrant shrink sleeve labels for bottles/cans.
- **Service Models**: OEM / ODM / Private Label manufacturing with factory-direct pricing.
